title: Newmark Appointed Exclusive Leasing Agent for 276,000-SF Retail Offering at Mizner Park in Boca Raton
summary: Newmark Group, Inc. announces it has been appointed as the exclusive retail leasing agent for Mizner Park, an approximately 840,000-square-foot mixed-use destination in downtown Boca Raton, Florida.
body_markdown: Newmark Group, Inc. announces it has been appointed as the exclusive retail leasing agent for Mizner Park, an approximately 840,000-square-foot mixed-use destination in downtown Boca Raton, Florida.
